The companion is finished: 30 chapters, 127 sections and 632 questions. Extract the archive at the repo root. It adds one Library row to `README.md` (after `see-what-you-made-me-do`) and creates `content/books/taxes-for-dummies-2026/`. Nothing needs deleting.

I couldn't run the repo's .NET compiler here, so I checked everything with a Python script that applies the same rules (ids, option counts, correct answers, YAML). I also checked 555 quotes against the book's text, with page numbers, and ran the worked arithmetic in Python.

**How it's laid out**
- **Chapters 1–27** follow the book's chapters in order.
- **Chapter 28** merges the book's three "Part of Tens" chapters into one.
- **Chapter 29** covers the 2026 tax year and what changed after the book was printed, plus a digest of the book's worst errors. The changes include:
  - IRS Direct File wasn't offered in 2026.
  - Automatic penalty relief replaces First Time Abate.
  - Paper refund checks are being phased out.
  - The enhanced premium tax credit expired.
  - The new Trump accounts for children started.
  - It also has the first 2027 figures.
- **Chapter 30** works through complete returns step by step: an engineer, a family, a freelancer (self-employment tax, the QBI deduction and a SEP) and retirees (Social Security plus the new senior deduction).

**The book's errors most likely to cost a reader money** (each is flagged where it comes up):
- The late-filing penalty is 5% a month, not 0.5% (p. 435).
- Home equity loan interest isn't deductible unless the money improves the home (pp. 538, 555, 583).
- Moving into a former rental for two years doesn't shelter the rental-years gain when you sell (p. 530).
- Inherited crypto gets a stepped-up basis like any other property (p. 336).
- The book never mentions portability, which lets a surviving spouse use the unused estate tax exemption (p. 565).
- Qualified charitable distributions from an IRA start at 70½, not 73 (p. 488).
- The dependent care credit phase-out the book gives applied only in 2021 (p. 547).
- The child tax credit phases out completely, not down to $2,000 (p. 362).
- The adoption credit is now partly refundable (p. 365).
- Smaller errors are also flagged where they come up: backup withholding rate, bank levy hold period, the 90-day letter deadline, the wash sale window, the QBI example, the capital gains table and the 2026 estimated tax due dates.

The explanations say it isn't tax or legal advice. I saved build notes with the figures used and the full corrections list to the project as `claude/taxes-for-dummies-companion-notes.md`.

# Taxes 2026 For Dummies companion — build notes

Slug: `taxes-for-dummies-2026` (Terlingua Magazine repo terlingua/terlingua.github.io). Delivered 2026-11-25 as a tar.gz with README.md (one new Library row after `see-what-you-made-me-do`) + `content/books/taxes-for-dummies-2026/`. No files to delete.

Source: Tyson & Eck, *Taxes 2026 For Dummies* (Wiley, 2025), covers tax year 2025. Book page = PDF page − 24.

## Shape
- 30 chapters, 127 sections, 632 questions (60 multi-answer), ~555 book quotes checked against the PDF text with page pointers.
- Chapters 1–27 follow the book; ch 28 merges the book's Part of Tens (book chs 28–30); ch 29 = tax year 2026, OBBBA provisions starting 2026, post-print developments, digest of the book's worst errors; ch 30 = worked returns (engineer with dividends/gains, family itemize vs standard + CTC + dependent care FSA, freelancer SE tax/QBI/SEP/safe harbor, retirees taxable SS + senior deduction, gain netting + NIIT).
- Cross-references: companion chapter numbers match the book for 1–27; book ch 30 references were repointed to companion ch 28.

## Key figures used (verify each year)
- 2025: SD 15,750/31,500/23,625; senior $6,000 each (2025–2028); SALT 40,000 (phase-down >500k MAGI, $10k floor); CTC 2,200 (refundable 1,700); 0% LTCG to 48,350/96,700/64,750; 15% to 533,400/600,050/566,700; saver's credit tiers 23,750/25,500/39,500 (single); nanny threshold 2,800; QCD 108,000; FEIE 130,000; 401k 23,500 (+7,500; 60–63 +11,250).
- 2026: SD 16,100/32,200/24,150; 0% LTCG to 49,450/98,900/66,200; 15% to 545,500/613,700/579,600; AMT exemption 90,100/140,200, phase-out 500k/1M at 50%; 401k 24,500 (+8,000; 60–63 11,250); IRA 7,500 (+1,100); HSA 4,400/8,750; SS wage base 184,500; mileage 72.5¢; SALT 40,400/505k; EBL 256k/512k; FEIE 132,900; DCAP 7,500; 529 K-12 20,000; 1099-NEC/MISC 2,000; 1099-K 20,000/200.
- 2027 (Rev. Proc. 2026-35): SD 33,200/16,600/24,925; CTC 2,300 (refundable 1,800); gift exclusion 20,000; estate 15.48M.
- Post-print: Direct File not offered for 2026 season; AEP replaces First Time Abate (IR-2026-83, July 8 2026; full replacement for returns due from Jan 1 2027); paper refund checks phased out from Sept 30 2025; enhanced PTC expired after 2025 (400% cliff back, no repayment caps); Trump accounts (Form 4547, contributions from July 4 2026); 1099-DA and Form 8949 boxes G–L.

## Most consequential corrections to the book (all flagged in-text)
Failure-to-file penalty 5%/month not 0.5% (p435); home equity interest not deductible unless home improvement (pp538, 555, 583); nonqualified use on rental-to-residence conversion (p530); inherited crypto gets step-up (p336); estate portability omitted (p565); QCD age 70½ (p488) and still-working RMD exception only for current employer plan; dependent care credit 125k/438k phase-out was 2021-only (p547); CTC phases to zero not $2,000 (p362); adoption credit $5,000 refundable (p365); simplified home office $5/$1,500 (pp292, 383); backup withholding 24% (p399); bank levy 21 days (p401); 90-day letter from mailing (p414); QBI example ignores taxable-income cap (p500); wash sale window includes 30 days before (p524); 110% safe harbor uses prior-year AGI and 2026 due dates June 15/Sept 15 (pp372–373); Table 24-1 capital-gain bands mix years (p512); kids' FICA exemption under 18 (p504); 403(b) has no 20% deferral cap (p477); 2011 estate exemption was $5M (p560); hobby rule is a profit presumption (p496); AOTC/LLC phase-outs not indexed and tuition deduction expired (p553). Full chapter-by-chapter list kept in the build workspace NOTES.md.

## Tooling (session workspace, not in repo)
Compact source format (`@@chapter`, `@@section slug | Title`, `@@q id [multiple] [keep]`, `-`/`+` options, `>` explanation) compiled by a Python builder that mirrors the repo's BookCompiler/QuestionCompiler rules (slug ids, ≥2 options, ≥1 correct, type inferred) and shuffles options deterministically; a quote checker verifies every “…” quote against the PDF text within ±1 page.
